string-array.name: on_boarding_description
string-array.item: Experience seamless management of your PDF documents.Quickly browse, rename, categorize, delete, and bookmark your files. Effortlessly handle multiple folders and ensure your important documents are always at your fingertips.
Easily browse through all your PDF documents stored on your device. Swipe left or right to quickly skip to the next or previous document, making it simple to find exactly what you\'re looking for.

Organize your PDFs by renaming them.
Add categories to file names for better sorting and easier access. This helps you keep your documents well-organized and quickly find the files you need.

Free up space by deleting unnecessary PDF documents with a simple tap.Bookmark important PDFs for quick and convenient access from the bookmarks section. This ensures that your most important documents are always just a tap away.

Access and manage PDFs across multiple folders. Easily browse through folders to find and organize your files. This feature helps you maintain a structured and accessible collection of documents, no matter where they are stored.
